processes.name: corporate web host
processes.source_excerpt: our corporate web host serves it

processes.name: dispatch console
processes.description: A single-page JavaScript application used by duty engineers.
processes.source_excerpt: The console is a single-page JavaScript app
processes.notes: Nobody wrote down how an engineer signs in to it.

processes.name: dispatch API
processes.description: The API called by the dispatch console and schedule importer.
processes.source_excerpt: The dispatch API reads and writes the dispatch database.

processes.name: schedule importer
processes.description: Pulls and parses the partner's SOAP feed and posts parsed work orders to the dispatch API.
processes.source_excerpt: Our schedule importer runs on the corporate network.
processes.notes: The importer presents an API token that was issued when it was built and has not been rotated.

data_stores.name: dispatch database
data_stores.description: Holds job orders, crew names, crew mobile numbers, and the token or session that created each job order.
data_stores.source_excerpt: That database holds the job orders, the crew names and the crew mobile numbers.

data_stores.name: schedule archive
data_stores.description: A folder containing each XML document downloaded from the scheduling partner.
data_stores.source_excerpt: It writes each document it downloads into the schedule archive

data_stores.name: corporate file store
data_stores.description: The file store containing the schedule archive folder.
data_stores.source_excerpt: a folder on the corporate file store

data_flows.name: load application
data_flows.description: The duty engineer loads the dispatch console application from the corporate web host.
data_flows.source_excerpt: They open the dispatch console in their browser.

data_flows.name: open console
data_flows.description: The duty engineer opens the dispatch console in a browser.
data_flows.source_excerpt: They open the dispatch console in their browser.

data_flows.name: call API
data_flows.description: The dispatch console calls the dispatch API.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The console calls the dispatch API.
data_flows.notes: The API answers the console cross-origin. The allowed origins and credential behavior are unknown.

data_flows.name: stream job status
data_flows.description: The dispatch console opens a WebSocket to the dispatch API for live job status.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The console also opens a WebSocket to the dispatch API and holds it open for live job status.
data_flows.notes: It is unknown whether the socket runs over TLS, whether its handshake is authenticated, or whether it checks the engineer's session again after opening.

data_flows.name: read-write data
data_flows.description: The dispatch API reads and writes the dispatch database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The dispatch API reads and writes the dispatch database.
data_flows.data_description: job orders, crew names, crew mobile numbers, and creator tokens or sessions

data_flows.name: pull planned work
data_flows.description: The schedule importer pulls the scheduling partner's SOAP feed every hour.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Every hour it pulls the partner's SOAP feed over HTTPS
data_flows.notes: It is unknown how the partner identifies the importer or how the importer identifies the partner.
data_flows.data_description: tomorrow's planned work in an XML document

data_flows.name: write archive
data_flows.description: The schedule importer writes each downloaded XML document into the schedule archive.
data_flows.source_excerpt: It writes each document it downloads into the schedule archive

data_flows.name: post work orders
data_flows.description: The schedule importer posts parsed work orders to the dispatch API using an API token.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The importer then posts the parsed work orders to the same dispatch API the console calls. It presents an API token.
data_flows.notes: The API token was issued when the importer was built and has not been rotated.
